// diagnostic

E1337

The requested environment module is not declared

What

The requested environment module is not declared

Why

One environment plan activates one `env.<name>` module; silently merging siblings would mix unrelated packages and variables.

Fix

Select one of the declared module names, or omit `--env` to use `dev`, then `default`, then lexical order.
